response.sql: WITH gender_counts AS (SELECT c.gender AS gender, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS cnt FROM Invoices i JOIN Orders o ON i.order_id = o.order_id JOIN Customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.gender), overall AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM gender_counts) SELECT AVG(g.cnt) AS avg_invoiced_orders, AVG(g.cnt - o.avg_cnt) AS avg_excess FROM gender_counts g CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE g.cnt > o.avg_cnt;
